<style>html,body{overflow:hidden!important;height:100%!important;background:#08080A!important}#odrDeck{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh;border:0;margin:0;padding:0;z-index:2147483647;background:#08080A;display:block}</style><script>(function(){if(document.getElementById("odrDeck"))return;var b="";var s=atob(b),u=new Uint8Array(s.length);for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++)u[i]=s.charCodeAt(i);new Response(new Blob([u]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"))).text().then(function(html){var f=document.createElement("iframe");f.id="odrDeck";f.title="Old Dominion Realty Proposal";f.setAttribute("allow","fullscreen; autoplay");f.setAttribute("allowfullscreen","");f.srcdoc=html;f.addEventListener("load",function(){try{f.contentWindow.focus()}catch(e){}});document.body.appendChild(f);});})();</script>
